items.item_text: High School Graduate General Studies and
Minimum of two (2) years of customer service experience., upon hire
Recent clerical experience within the last five years
Five (5) years in healthcare related clerical support experience

Act as liaison between the assigned executive(s) and management personnel, Dignity Health corporate office, board members,medical staff, prominent community leaders, visitors, clergy and hospital personnel.

Serve as the facility Policy Site Administrator. Coordinate and manage hospital policies, procedures, and hospital plans through the appropriate stages and committees for approval. Maintain and upload policy, procedure, and plan database.

Coordinate functions such as business meetings, social events which would include catering, reserving location, assisting putting together information for meetings, preparing other items for events, and communicating to attendees ensuring accommodations, etc.

Receive and screen telephone calls; answer routine and specific questions, take accurate messages and keep assigned executive(s) informed of identity and nature of calls handled during absence. Handle the assigned executive's incoming mail according to content and take action accordingly. Take initiative in preparing response to correspondence, alleviating the assigned executive(s) of the task of preparing a response personally when appropriate. Assist with requests for use of classrooms and meeting rooms. Provide as back up for the other executive assistants in the office when requested.

Arrange and maintain a reasonable smooth-flowing calendar for the assigned executive(s) and ensure the appropriate materials are available for meetings. Take initiative to reschedule appointments when necessary. Schedule meetings accordingly. Prepare agendas for meetings upon assigned executive(s) request; follow up on agenda items requiring follow up as directed. Act as recording secretary for meetings upon request of the assigned executive(s). Transcribe minutes in a timely manner. Coordinate travel arrangements and seminar registration for the assigned executive(s) and other leaders as requested.
